runtime_evidence.note: Actual link map includes libc, libdlmalloc, compiler_rt stack_ops; generated JS runtime covered by complete Emscripten LICENSE including third-party text. C++ libraries generated in cache but no linked members observed; not claimed as linked.

verification.codec_note: V1 binary/ABI tests retained because the paired C/WASM/glue are unchanged. Its recorded source-TS encode-failure leak is fixed in v2; see cleanup acceptance.
verification.v2_unchanged_outputs: All 207 other dist files match original npm package byte-for-byte; only 8 WebP-dependent dist JS/map files plus paired lib/webp.mjs/wasm are replaced.

limits: No production/public/default license collection modified; whole app not rebuilt.
Historical original npm WebP binary provenance remains unresolved. These are independently derived artifacts, not original npm bytes.
Transparent alpha=0 hidden RGB may change with unchanged simple libwebp API; opaque/nonzero-alpha RGBA assertions are byte exact.
Ordinary Node CJS require fails with playcanvas.Vec3 is not a constructor in both original and candidate. Actual ESM external-adapted CJS path passes; no upstream fix or broader CJS support claimed.

Initial Rollup CLI wrote all files then retained idle handles and was terminated exit143; API driver wrote and closed every bundle successfully exit0 with identical files, then explicitly exited after declaration copy.
Browser worker, WKWebView/native UI and full-application exported-format acceptance remain integration work.
integration_requirements: Apply all ten checksum-bound overlay files after npm ci; never only replace WASM.
Bind base package manifest, original-file hashes, compressed and decompressed payload hashes/sizes, and this build-evidence file hash.
Include overlay/build identity in prepare cache signature and verify cached files.
Preserve old license collection; create a new collection with these exact originals and source/runtime bindings.
Retain source/SDK download URLs and hashes for rebuild; do not put ~297MB SDK in the app.
Use native Node gzip decompression for normal cross-platform prepare; no SDK required for consumption.
path_base: Every relative path in this document is relative to the webp-rebuild-20261028 evidence staging root; v2/ is a versioned subdirectory.
cleanup_fix_scope: Verified 22 primary cases, 44 recovery calls and 5 exact v1/v2 successful-output comparisons. Includes C false returns, input/output copy JS exceptions, exception immediately after real C output, partial malloc exceptions and safely mocked malloc null. No real OOM or arbitrary-pointer safety claim.
